TIL that Shark Tank contestants were once required to give the show’s production company either 5% equity or 2% of their business’ profits for as long as it existed, even if no Shark invested. Mark Cuban threatened to quit over the clause, which was abolished retroactively in 2013

TIL that the famous painting "Saturn Devouring His Son" was not painted on a canvas. Goya painted it secretely, straight into the walls of his house while in isolation and in declining mental health. It was only discovered when he left in exile. It originally featured an erect penis.

TIL in 2014, a California nursing home was shut down and abandoned by trained staff. Sixteen residents, some with dementia, were left behind. Seeing the need, the nursing home’s cook and janitor worked several days cooking, bathing and dispensing medications to residents until authorities arrived.
TIL that the psychic staring effect, where you can feel someone's gaze on you, has never held up to rigorous research.

TIL the NBA shot clock exists because of a 1950 game the Pistons won 19-18 by holding the ball for minutes at a time without shooting. Syracuse owner Danny Biasone worked out 24 seconds by dividing 48 minutes by 120 shots, and the clock started in 1954
TIL that dogs can smell when a human is stressed, detecting changes in breath and sweat with over 93% accuracy.

TIL that in 1900, Chicago deliberately changed the direction of the Chicago River so that the city's sewage would flow away from its drinking water supply. The river now drains into the Mississippi River instead of Lake Michigan.
TIL: the longest distance traveled on a single tank of fuel is 2,831KM (1759 miles); it was achieved by Milo Marczyk from 5-7 March 2025. He averaged 2.61/100km (90 MPG US) in a diesel Skoda Superb

TIL that in former Dutch colonies and places indirectly influenced by the Dutch, like South Africa and Botswana, they still use Roman-Dutch law based on the principles of the Justinian Code. The Netherlands itself abandoned it under Napoleonic rule.
TIL fighter aircraft drop tanks were once constructed of paper to save metal. They were single use as the fuel would dissolve them over time causing leaks.
